messages.content: Give me the price of a Tesla model S in India.

function.name: get_exchange_rate
function.description: Retrieve the current exchange rate between two currencies. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
**Tesla Model S – India**

> **Official status:** Tesla has not yet launched the Model S (or any other vehicle) in India, so there is no published retail price or availability schedule.

> **What you can expect if/when it arrives:**  
> • The U.S. MSRP for a new Model S starts at roughly **$90 000** (about **₹7.4 million** at an exchange rate of ₹82 per dollar).  
> • Import duties, GST, and local taxes in India can add **30–50 %** (or more) to that figure, pushing the final price into the **₹10–12 million** range.  
> • Tesla’s own pricing strategy in other markets (e.g., Australia, Japan) shows that they often set a higher base price to cover logistics and regulatory costs, so the Indian price could be even higher.

**Bottom line:** There is no official price yet, but if Tesla were to launch the Model S in India, you could expect a price somewhere between **₹10 million and ₹12 million**, depending on taxes and import duties.
